name: FaceOnMOve
description:
Automatically rotates and/or flips tokens to face their direction of movement.

When a token moves, FaceOnMOve turns it to face the way it went — rotating toward the movement angle (clamped and optionally snapped to horizontal), flipping single-image tokens left/right, or swapping to dedicated side art on rollable tokens (including separate up/down art for steep movement). Configuration layers as global defaults → per-character overrides → per-token overrides, all editable from an interactive menu.

**Requires [ScriptKit](https://github.com/Roll20/roll20-api-scripts/tree/master/ScriptKit)** for help, man, whatsnew, and handout generation.

**Getting started:** Select one or more tokens and run `!fomo` (or `!fomo menu`) to open the config menu. Use the Global tab to set defaults, or the Token/Character tabs to override for the selection. For most single-image tokens, the only setting that matters is Facing (Left/Right).

**v1.0.0 - New features:**
- Initial release
- Face movement direction via rotation and/or horizontal flip
- Rollable-token side swapping (left/right and steep up/down art)
- Global, per-token, and per-character config layering
- Interactive config menu with side picker and Facing controls
- Waypoint grouping, snap-to-horizontal, in-place facing gestures, idle reset
- Global master switch and status-marker exclusions
- ScriptKit integration: help, man, whatsnew, motd, gen-help

Commands:
- `!fomo menu` -- Open the config menu (same as bare !fomo; uses selection or global) (GM)
- `!fomo enable` -- Enable facing for selected tokens
- `!fomo disable` -- Disable facing for selected tokens
- `!fomo on` -- Global master switch ON (GM)
- `!fomo off` -- Global master switch OFF (GM)
- `!fomo toggle` -- Flip the global master switch (GM)
- `!fomo face [<id>|default] <left|right|inherit>` -- Set default facing; inherit clears a token/character override; default = global (GM)
- `!fomo set <key> <value>` -- Set a global default (GM)
- `!fomo set-token [<id>] <key> <value>` -- Set a token-level override; uses selection if no id (GM)
- `!fomo set-char [<id>] <key> <value>` -- Set a character-level override; accepts token or character id (GM)
- `!fomo reset-token [<id>]` -- Clear token-level overrides (id form GM-only)
- `!fomo reset-char [<id>]` -- Clear character-level overrides (GM)
- `!fomo reset-all [--force]` -- Reset ALL tokens to defaults (GM)
- `!fomo reset-global [--force]` -- Restore global defaults to factory values (GM)
